selected.title: Memory-bounded spectral representation scheduling
selected.difficulty: Joint route, cache, variable-size eviction, layout and version-lifetime decisions; local shortest paths do not solve the global problem.

selected.title: Robust false-convergence counterexample
selected.difficulty: Search for a nonlinear, resolved and reproducible discrepancy that fools a supplied convergence certificate, with independent reference checks.

selected.title: Robust nonlinear field-control construction
selected.difficulty: Construct one constrained control artifact that works across continuous physical uncertainty, not merely at a nominal system.

unbuilt.title: Repair historical transform compiler regressions
unbuilt.reason: Risks becoming reproduction of later source fixes rather than a new capability gap.

unbuilt.title: Predict stochastic blow-up from short trajectories
unbuilt.reason: Reliable tail labels and separation of distribution shift from noise need more expensive data auditing.

unbuilt.title: Active identification of nonlocal SPDE couplings
unbuilt.reason: Identifiability and information-budget calibration are less mature than the selected design task.

unbuilt.title: General high-order interaction-picture time integrator
unbuilt.reason: Often reducible to implementing an established exponential Runge-Kutta method.

unbuilt.title: Parity-aware mixed-basis transform kernel
unbuilt.reason: Formula and symmetry are too completely specified; standard matrix/FFT implementation is insufficiently hard.

unbuilt.title: Temporal error check misses spatial aliasing
unbuilt.reason: A simple unresolved Fourier mode gives a trivial witness; selected counterexample must instead audit numerical resolution.

unbuilt.title: Multipath work-distribution scheduler
unbuilt.reason: Without difficult dependencies this reduces to standard load balancing.

selection_rule: Empirical hardness, trustworthy evaluation, substantive paper connection, and three different primary verification modes. Unbuilt ideas have no participant package.
